FIELDS.NAME: Grace Community Church
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Grace Community Church operates as a welcoming and inclusive place of worship dedicated to serving our local community. Our core operations include hosting regular worship services, Bible studies, and community outreach programs that aim to support individuals and families in need. We gather weekly on Sundays for worship, accompanied by activities for all ages, including children's ministries and youth groups, fostering a strong sense of community and spiritual growth. We prioritize safety and responsibility, ensuring all staff and volunteers undergo thorough background checks, especially those working with minors. Our facilities are maintained to meet current safety standards, and we conduct regular inspections to ensure a secure environment for all our members. We focus on providing a supportive space where individuals can find spiritual nourishment and connection through various faith-based programs and service opportunities.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, Grace Community Church experienced water damage from a burst pipe in the basement due to severe weather, resulting in repair costs amounting to $1,500. The claim has been settled, and the repairs were completed by June 1, 2023.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Fire-resistant safe, Class B, UL Listed.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing and a monitored alarm system are in place to enhance safety and deter unauthorized access, ensuring a secure environment for church services and community activities.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Grace Community Church has not been involved in storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials as part of its operations. The church focuses on community outreach and worship services without engagement in any activities that would involve hazardous materials.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Grace Community Church does not sponsor any athletic teams as part of its operations, focusing instead on worship services and community outreach programs.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance as it ensures proper risk transfer. A designated person within the organization is responsible for checking these certificates.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – Grace Community Church has not had any applicants indicted or convicted of fraud, bribery, arson, or any related crimes in connection with this or any other property. The organization prioritizes integrity and safety in its operations.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Grace Community Church has not had any policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior 3 years. The church has maintained a consistent insurance history with its previous carrier.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Grace Community Church does not lease employees to or from other employers, as all staff are directly employed by the church to maintain consistent operations and oversight.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Grace Community Church carries Workers' Compensation insurance to ensure the safety and protection of its employees in accordance with legal requirements.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – Grace Community Church does not own or operate any other business, as it focuses solely on its operations as a place of worship and community support.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Grace Community Church does not currently hold any other insurance policies with this company. The church's focus is solely on its existing coverage for its operations.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Grace Community Church is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products, as our focus is solely on providing a place of worship and community assistance. Our operations center around spiritual growth and outreach programs rather than product-related activities.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Grace Community Church does not rent or loan equipment to others, as our focus is on providing a safe environment for worship and community support without engaging in equipment rental activities.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Grace Community Church has not experienced any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien in the past five years. The church maintains financial stability and sound management practices.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Grace Community Church does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals in its operations, as it primarily focuses on worship services and community outreach without engaging in such activities.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Grace Community Church does not have any catastrophe exposure, as its operations focus on worship services and community outreach without engaging in high-risk activities. The facilities are well-maintained and comply with safety standards to minimize potential risks.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Grace Community Church has not had any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The church prioritizes safety and conducts thorough background checks for all staff and volunteers.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Grace Community Church currently has no uncorrected fire code violations and maintains compliance with all relevant safety standards. Regular inspections are conducted to ensure ongoing safety and code adherence.
